verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an iOS Git client, but the pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. The only privacy-related evidence says the AI features (Code Agent, commit suggestions) are opt-in and send staged diffs to OpenAI. That is an adjacent control over AI data sharing, not an opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
